curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42122-1-1.pdf (one book; the function page is page 118)

functions.does: The 12 tooth gear on top at the back, between the roll bars, steers the front wheels: a long shaft with two universal joints runs down and forward through the front axle's turntable, and a crank on its front end swings the steering bar across the axle, which turns both front hubs.
functions.source: book: page 118 (top inset, the gear with a turning arrow and a front wheel steering), steps 25-35 (the shaft and the gear on top), 47-53 (the front axle and steering bar)

functions.does: The front axle swings side to side on a turntable under the chassis, so the front wheels follow rough ground (pendular suspension).
functions.source: book: page 118 (bottom inset, the axle articulating over rough ground), steps 27-35 and 47-53
functions.note: The steering shaft runs through the turntable's centre, so the axle swings round it without steering the wheels much.

functions.does: The rear axle swings side to side on its own turntable under the back of the chassis (pendular suspension), between two shock absorbers that telescope as it swings.
functions.source: book: page 118 (bottom inset), steps 6 (the turntable) and the rear axle and shock steps; the shocks telescoping is inferred from the parts

functions.does: The two shock absorbers' springs push the rear axle back level.
functions.source: inferred: the rear shock absorbers carry springs (22977)
functions.skip: only matters under force; the axle's swing is modelled without it

functions.does: The 16 tooth gear on the front bumper winds the winch drum, reeling the string in or out to raise or lower the tow hook.
functions.source: book: page 118 (main picture, the gear with a turning arrow and the hook on its string), steps 76-82
functions.note: The hook (p242 30395) hangs on the string, which the file draws as a fixed rope.

functions.does: The bonnet lifts open, hinged at its back edge by the windscreen, showing the engine.
functions.source: book: page 118 (middle inset, the bonnet open)
book: page 118 (middle inset, a door open), steps 171-176 (the doors)

functions.does: The rear seat's backrest folds forward.
functions.source: inferred: steps 132-138 build the rear seat on pins and hubs (10197) so its back can turn; the book doesn't show it folding

functions.does: The four wheels roll freely; there's no drivetrain.
functions.source: book: page 118; steps 47-58 and the rear axle steps (the wheels are on plain axles in the axle beams)
